title: The self-update stub checks, applies, and relaunches on the new version; a broken version reverts to last-good
binding: Both legs prepare the debug bundle, publish complete signed development releases, and install 1.0.0 through UpdateService. The installed baseline applies 2.0.0 through the same chain. The positive leg observes the stub launch 2.0.0; the discriminating leg installs an unhealthy release without its executable, observes the refused launch, then the generation-safe rollback to healthy 1.0.0.

expect.name: the pointer ends on the applied version
the broken version refuses to launch
the pointer reverts to the last-good version
